MIYABISTS2-COMBAT_HARD_SELECTED.title: Challenge Difficulty
MIYABISTS2-COMBAT_HARD_SELECTED.hover.de:
Higher difficulty also grants [gold]bonus benefits[/gold]. This is penance, and also training.
[gold]1. Antimony[/gold]: Enemies +10% HP
[gold]2. Zinc[/gold]: At the start of each Act, randomly [red]downgrade[/red] a card
[gold]3. Tin[/gold]: The first card played each turn costs [red]+1[/red]
[gold]4. Manganese[/gold]: At combat start, enemies gain 1 Strength, you lose 1 Strength
[gold]5. Cadmium[/gold]: Enemies +20% HP instead
[gold]6. Nickel[/gold]: [red]Draw 1 fewer card[/red] for the first 3 turns
[gold]7. Copper[/gold]: Enemies deal 6 damage on death
[gold]8. Bismuth[/gold]: Enemies +30% HP, gain 1 additional Strength
[gold]9. Lead[/gold]: Upon entering a new Act, add a random [red]Curse[/red] to your deck
[gold]10. Mercury[/gold]: The first time an enemy would take lethal damage, they gain 1 [gold]Buffer[/gold], 2 [gold]Strength[/gold], and recover 30% HP
MIYABISTS2-FUN_PILE_SELECTED.title: Special Starting Deck
MIYABISTS2-FUN_PILE_SELECTED.hover.title: Choose Starting Deck
MIYABISTS2-FUN_PILE_SELECTED.hover.desc:
Choose a different special starting deck for your challenge.
[gold]Default[/gold]: No change
[gold]Bangboo Rulers[/gold]: Starting deck becomes Bangboo-themed
[gold]Swarm Assembly[/gold]: Add 1 upgraded [gold]Swarm Assembly[/gold] to your starting deck
